SAE tiling · OpenMOSS-Team/Llama3_1-8B-Base-LXR-8x/Llama3_1-8B-Base-L19R-8x

Bhalla et al. 2026 Sec. 5 ask whether a small, fixed group of SAE atoms spans the manifold (compact capture) or whether it is spread over many partially redundant atoms (dilution). The paper's own SAEs were not released; this uses the public Llama Scope layer-19 SAE for the same base model (JumpReLU, 32k features). On these 1848 prompts the SAE fires 27.6 features per token on average and rebuilds 53% of the activation energy (cosine 0.73); relative to the within-manifold spread its reconstruction error is 19.8x that spread (variance explained -18.81).
